pins.window_note: This watch re-anchors its window to each load's newest data date, so it usually tracks a moving period. Where two loads land inside the same period it resolves to the same dates, and the change between them is late-arriving data rather than a movement — each tile publishes the dates it actually measured, so a reader never has to guess which of the two they are looking at.

cards.title: DNFB accumulation: Northgate general-surgery discharges
cards.description: Federal Medicare / Northgate Regional Hospital / General Surgery: 22 unbilled discharges totaling $178,217 in window 2026-07-03..2026-07-29.
cards.impact_reconciliation_note: The detection system reported $178,216.82 for this cell over 2026-07-03..2026-07-29. This platform re-derived $195,873.92 from the governed dnfb_dollars contract. The two are not comparable: the governed contract is a snapshot (an as-of balance at the watermark) and applies no start..end window, while the card's figure was computed over one, so the gap between them is a difference of measurement kind rather than of population, window or valuation basis. The difference is not attributed to the detector, and this card is excluded from the divergence count.
cards.ranked_on_note: ranked on the detection system's figure ($178,216.82): this platform's re-derivation is not a comparable quantity (an as-of balance against a windowed flow), so substituting it would change the claim rather than correct it.
cards.actionability_rationale: Discharged-not-final-billed dollars are not lost, only unbilled: the account exists, the charges exist, and finishing the bill recovers them. The small unrecoverable residue is the coding or documentation gap that never closes. Deliberately below DUPLICATE's certainty and above every recovery category — DNFB is the cheapest money in the portfolio, which is exactly why it should outrank larger, harder items.
cards.lead_status_note: Coding is clearing the 22 held general-surgery accounts this week.

time_to_impact.method: Discharged-not-final-billed inventory: the account exists and the charges exist, so the cash arrives once the bill drops and the payer pays. Projected as the governed bill window plus the governed payment lag, from the median age of this cell's accounts. PROJECTION, not a deadline: 4 days to bill plus 28 days of governed payment lag = 32 days, against a days_since_discharge.median of 15 days. Both figures are planning defaults from the pack, not a payer contract, which is why this is marked provisional.

cards.title: Medical-necessity denial spike: Summit Peak MA Cardiology
cards.description: Summit Peak Medicare Advantage / Cardiology: 27 denials totaling $170,643 in window 2026-06-20..2026-07-28.
cards.impact_reconciliation_note: The detection system reported $170,643.00 for this cell in its own window (2026-06-20..2026-07-28), on its own population and valuation basis, when it fired. This platform re-derived $177,202.87 from the governed denied_dollars contract at the pinned watermark over the same named cell. They differ by $6,559.87 (+3.8%): the detector's window, population or valuation basis is not the contract's. The drill answers with the contract's figure and a real evidence grade; the card's figure remains the detection system's assertion, which is what it has always been.
cards.ranked_on_note: ranked on this platform's re-derived figure ($177,202.87 from the governed denied_dollars contract), not the detector's $170,643.00: the two diverge, and ordering the worklist by a number this payload disputes would rank the work on the side of the disagreement the platform does not stand behind. The detector's figure is kept above as its own assertion.
cards.actionability_rationale: Recoverability follows the appealable share of the denied claims; non-appealable denials route to prevention, not recovery.
cards.drill_repoint_rationale: The detector published a dollar impact under a ratio metric that is also unprobeable at its own grain (REMIT is not bound for the claim entity). denied_dollars measures the same population in the unit the card actually reports.

time_to_impact.method: The cash effect has already landed: these claims were adjudicated and did not pay. What is still open is the appeal window, which the detector dates directly.

cards.title: Contract-rate reset (working as designed): Veritas Comp orthopedics
cards.description: Veritas Comp Fund / Orthopedic Surgery / ORTHO-SURG: 45 reduced-rate claims totaling $493,266 in window 2026-05-01..2026-06-25.
cards.impact_reconciliation_note: the platform could not re-derive this figure: 'gross_collection_rate' declares unit 'ratio' — a non-money contract produces no comparable dollar figure, so there is nothing to reconcile against the card's dollar impact (any money column in its frame is an internal numerator, not the metric) Part of this gap is this platform's own doing, not the detector's: the drill was repointed onto a different cut (proc_group → primary_proc_group) because the governed contract has no legal cut at the detector's dimension, so the two figures are measured over related — not identical — populations. See drill_dimension_repoints.
cards.ranked_on_note: ranked on the detection system's figure ($493,266.36): this platform has no re-derived figure for this card, so there is no reconciled number to rank it on instead.
cards.actionability_rationale: Working-as-designed contractual adjustments are not an error; the dollars are not recoverable and the anomaly is informational.

drill_dimension_repoints.rationale: Procedures bind at claim_line, so a claim-grain contract cannot be cut by `proc_group` at all. `primary_proc_group` is the claim's dominant procedure group (largest share of billed charges, ties broken by name), certified at the claim and transaction grains. Read the drill as an attribution of whole claims, not a decomposition of lines: the detector counted lines in this group, and the drill counts claims whose largest procedure group is this one.

time_to_impact.method: Contractual allowance is the negotiated discount working as designed. It has already hit cash and there is nothing to recover, so there is no future cash event to date.
time_to_impact.reason: Contractual allowance is the negotiated discount working as designed. It has already hit cash and there is nothing to recover, so there is no future cash event to date.
